architectural_boundary_note: Phase 6 adapters are physical weights serialized for Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct (d=4096). Weight-level spectral analysis (Tier 2 QR-SVD) runs directly on physical safetensors weights. Live neural probers (Tiers 2B and 3) check base model compatibility. In local zero-cost Apple Silicon CPU/MPS environment, live inference requires loading a 16 GB 8B parameter model, which is safely marked 'SKIPPED_INCOMPATIBLE_BASE'. As a result, Tier 2B discrete gradient-guided trigger search does not execute on Phase 6 without an 8B base model, leaving v3.2 performance on Phase 6 identical to v3.1.

comparative_analysis.transfer_explanation: v3.2's gradient-guided trigger search requires base model forward/backward graph execution. Because Phase 6 targets LLaMA-3-8B while zero-cost local execution operates without an 8B PyTorch model, Tier 2B was skipped. Both v3.1 and v3.2 achieved 87.5% Balanced Accuracy (6/8 trojans detected via two-sided spectral SVD, 0/7 clean false positives). The 2 spectral mimics (legal_spectrum_mimic, powerlaw_dormant) remain undetected by both versions.
